name: Transcendence Charge
note: Gains +1 per day up to a stored cap of 14 per character, likely feeds Transcendence dungeon entries, see w-transcendence-dungeon

name: Dimensional Invasion
note: Gains +1 per day, account-wide stored cap of 7, occurs on a half-hour spawn cadence

name: Nightmare Dungeon
note: Solo content, 10 difficulty tiers, drops Dream Fragments for a special shop

name: Heroic dungeon farm
note: About 3 runs a day recommended for purple gear, no hard lockout confirmed, this is a guideline not an enforced cap

name: Mission Quests
note: 5 per day, refresh at reset

name: Daily attendance login
note: Checked via the in-game Attendance menu, resets 00:00 server time, 14-day and 28-day attendance cycles reported

name: Shugo Fiesta Key
note: Gains +2 per day, account-wide stored cap of 14, runs hourly, guides warn against spending these before max level since it reduces endgame reward value

name: Odyle Energy spend
note: Spent to open a dungeon reward cube, 40 energy for a normal cube, 60 for Hard, shared pool across Exploration, Party, and Transcendence dungeons; starts accruing around level 22; cap is contested, roughly 560, possibly a weekly-accumulation figure rather than a hard cap; don't let it sit full, regen is wasted

name: Daily Dungeons
note: Confusingly named Daily Dungeons but the entry count resets weekly on Wednesday, free 7 clears, expandable to 30 via Bio-Research Base Challenge Tickets, drops Enhancement Stones

name: Party Dungeons & Raids
note: About 10-minute runs with mini-bosses plus a main boss, drops upgrade stones and gear

name: Expeditions
note: Cap is contested, one source says 3 per week and another says 21 per week, used the lower number; party size is also contested at 4, 5, or 8 players; core gearing content for Arcana cards and upgrade materials

name: Transcendence Dungeon
note: Cap is contested, one source says 2 per week and another says 14 per week, used the lower number, may reflect different content sharing a name or a KR patch change over time; described as the best energy-to-reward ratio for the 40-energy cube

name: Conquest Dungeon
note: High-value gear via a 40-energy (60 for Hard) reward cube, the minimum listed item-level requirement is called misleadingly low, real recommended is roughly 1400 to 1500 item level, exact weekly entry count not confirmed

name: Abyss Citadel
note: 5-player party PvE with optional PvP flagging, weekly lockout, exact entry count not stated

name: Sanctum Library
note: 5-player pure PvE with 4 role-specific bosses, weekly lockout, exact entry count not stated

name: The Eternity Breach
note: 12-player raid, 7 bosses across 4 wings, Normal, Heroic, and Mythic tiers share one weekly lockout, this raid name appears in only one low-confidence source, treat as unverified

name: Ladra Raid
note: 10-player raid, weekly reward reset, exact entry count not stated

name: Sanctuary
note: Large-group endgame raid content with valuable weekly rewards, exact entry count not stated

name: Ascension Trial
note: Gear-score gated, contested threshold, roughly 1000 in one source versus roughly 1500 for a Forgotten Repository version in another; guides call it a limited weekly attempt but the exact count is not stated directly, don't attempt below the real item-level bar, it wastes the weekly shot

name: Legendary-tier dungeons
note: Gold-quality gear difficulty tier applied across multiple dungeons, not a single instance, weekly-limited but exact count unverified

name: Abyss access hours
note: Free-player weekly time limit inside the Abyss open-world PvP zone, doubled to roughly 14 hours with paid membership

name: Energy recharge stones
note: Crafted stone restores 40 energy each, a second source describes the same weekly cap of 7 under the name Odella Energy crafting, naming is contested but the number of 7 agrees across both, weekly reset reported as Wednesday 05:00

name: Dungeon runs (84-cap)
note: Account-wide soft cap, combined dungeon clears past 84 per week reportedly cut tradeable Kinah and gear drops by 90 percent for the rest of the week across all characters, mainly relevant if running multiple alts, a second breakpoint around 126 runs is mentioned for non-Kinah rewards but is unverified
